classification: B. Parameter sensitivity / numerical convergence study
wiggle_detection_method: scipy.signal.argrelextrema(order=3) within +-5nm of junction; closest local-min/local-max pair taken as the ripple (matches M03 investigation fork's original method)
verdict: Numerical artifact (Case 1 in the original classification): both junctions show amplitude decreasing sharply under mesh refinement (right: -63%, left: wiggle vanishes entirely). Only 2 mesh levels tested (Case 2 at h_refined=0.3 crashed with ArrayMemoryError from over-broad refined_region scope -- see script comments) so this is not a fully converged 3+-point series, but the direction and magnitude of change strongly favor numerical origin over a physical feature.
